patch_list: Tops up each booster to 999 every time the game starts.
Starts every level with five extra moves.
Stops ad networks from starting and blocks rewarded and interstitial ads.
Gives unlimited lives for 24 hours every time the game starts.
Opens all booster slots from level 2.
